Definition: The fraction of the bases that are aligned to the baited region (bases on target .bed) / (total bases sequenced)
The average number of sequences bases per base of target region in the .bed.
The fraction of the mapped sequence that is a duplicated because of PCR amplification.
The fraction of all target bases achieving 20X or greater coverage.
Definitions can be found at https://github.com/brentp/somalier
Coefficient of relationship is 1.00 when samples are identical: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coefficient_of_relationship.
Number of sites not matching (one sample is hom-ref and the other is hom-alt).
Number of sites matching (two samples have same genotype).
